messages.subject: One of my Linkage Group Started from 50cM
messages.subject_clean: One of my Linkage Group Started from 50cM
messages.body_plain:
I'm recently constructing my genetic map, step by step with the tutorial.
One thing I noticed is that my chr11 always started from 50cM instead of 0cM,
No matter how many times I reorder my markers.

It still looks good on PlotMap() though.
Does anyone know where's the problem and how to fix it? thx.

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] One of my Linkage Group Started from 50cM
messages.subject_clean: [Rqtl-disc] One of my Linkage Group Started from 50cM
messages.body_plain:
You can use the function shiftmap() <https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/qtl/html/shiftmap.html> to shift the starting position of all chromosomes to 0.

karl

messages.subject: How to create a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome
messages.subject_clean: How to create a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome
messages.body_plain:
Hi.

I would like to make a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome.

But, when I ran the code below, both thresholds is displayed on all chromosomes.

data <- calc.genoprob(data, step=1, error.prob=0.001)
out.1 <- scanone(data, pheno.col=1, method="hk")
operm.1 <- scanone(data, pheno.col=1, method="hk",n.perm = 1000,perm.Xsp = TRUE,verbose = F,n.cluster = 6)
summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.05)
summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.10)

summary(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.05, pvalues=TRUE)
summary(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.10, pvalues=TRUE)

plot(out.1, alternate.chrid=T)
abline(h = summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.05),col = "red")
abline(h = summary(operm.1, alpha = 0.10),col = "blue")

Can I display only autosomal threshold on autosomal graphs and sex chromosomal thresholds on sex chromosomal graphs?

Thank you for your help.

messages.subject: Re: How to create a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome
messages.subject_clean: How to create a graph that displays the LOD score threshold separately for autosome and sex chromosome
messages.body_plain:
Use the function add.threshold() <https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/qtl/html/add.threshold.html>

    add.threshold(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.05, col="red")
    add.threshold(out.1, perms=operm.1, alpha=0.10, col="blue")

karl

messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.62
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.62) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

We fixed a couple of small bugs, in summary.scanone() for format="onepheno" and in read.cross() for format="csvs".

Karl Broman
